training-data.bio: Podcast: Knowing What Your Customers Want, All the Time: Listen Labs' Alfred Wahlforss

html_en:
The AI industry is witnessing a striking convergence around conversational interfaces and practical business applications, as coding agents mature from experimental tools to enterprise solutions and customer research transforms through AI-powered voice interactions.

The Rise of Conversational AI Infrastructure

The shift toward conversational interfaces is accelerating across multiple fronts. Guillermo Rauch captured this transformation perfectly, arguing that we're moving beyond the "no-code" era into what he calls "YES-CODE":
"An entire category of software, 'no-code', was built under the presumption that code is expensive, difficult, and scarce. Coding agents have forever changed the equation. Code is now cheap, easy, and abundant."
This philosophical shift is playing out in practical ways. Josh Woodward announced that "Thinking Levels are now available on Gemini across Web, iOS, and Android", while Tom Quinonero highlighted major advances in Claude's capabilities, noting that "Workflows are the biggest upgrade to Claude Code's capabilities since skills and subagents." The implications extend beyond coding. As Rauch observed: "English alone could not produce tangible things. You had to translate it into machine instruction, through learning or delegation to others. You can now go direct."

Enterprise AI Adoption Accelerates

The enterprise market is showing remarkable appetite for AI agents, with several major partnerships announced. Amjad Masad revealed Replit's collaboration with Microsoft, stating they're "excited to partner with @Microsoft to enable everyone in the enterprise to build and deploy safe & secure Fabric data apps." Meanwhile, Peter Steinberger announced another significant enterprise deal, calling it "such a privilege to work with Microsoft to bring claws to enterprises!" The adoption metrics are striking. Zara Zhang shared data from OpenAI's latest Codex report showing that "Knowledge workers now represent about 20% of Codex users and are adopting it more than 3 times as fast as developers."

The SaaS Disruption Question

As AI agents become more capable, traditional SaaS models face increasing pressure. Peter Yang articulated this challenge thoughtfully:
"If you're building a simple SaaS for a narrow use case, I think it's harder to monetize now because: 1. AI skills can often solve the same problem in a much more flexible, personalized way. 2. AI-native agents like Codex / Claude Code that have a user's personal context and memory have far more knowledge to solve the user's problem vs. a standalone SaaS website or chatbot."
Aaron Levie offered a complementary perspective on the economic implications, arguing that "model routing is the inevitable conclusion" as token costs become a larger part of operating expenses. He predicts that "products that can intelligently route these workflows to the right tier of model will be in a strong position to aggregate more demand."

Voice-First Customer Research Revolution

One of the most compelling examples of AI transformation comes from Listen Labs, whose CEO Alfred Wahlforss described their AI-first customer research platform in a detailed podcast interview. The company has built what he calls "an AI agent that can understand your customers better than you can" by conducting voice interviews at scale.
"We have 30,000,000 participants. We can find pretty much anyone from an oncologist to a software engineer, and we'll go and actually talk to them and have hundreds of those interviews and then analyze the data, give you recommendations."
The platform addresses a fundamental limitation of traditional surveys. As Wahlforss explained: "We went back to the same person and asked them a multiple choice survey again, and they were radically inconsistent... But we did the same thing with listen when you actually have to think and you have to really reason through your answer and then you're much more consistent." The approach has yielded practical insights for major brands, from helping Chubbies discover that "chest hair interface really poorly with one of the materials they have" to enabling Manscaped to optimize their Super Bowl advertising.

Looking Ahead

Sam Altman weighed in on policy developments, expressing support for the new executive order: "the US should lead on AI by continuing to develop the very best models, making sure they're safe, and getting cyber tools into the hands of trusted defenders. the new EO gets the balance right." As the industry matures, we're seeing a clear trend toward practical, business-focused applications that leverage conversational interfaces to solve real problems. The question isn't whether AI will transform traditional software categories—it's how quickly enterprises can adapt to this new reality.
html_zh:
代理智能的融合正在重新定义商业和技术的边界——从企业AI平台的快速增长，到传统SaaS模式面临的挑战，再到"是代码"时代的到来。

🤖 代理时代：ChatGPT与Codex引领变革

AI代理正在成为技术生态系统的核心。Thomas Sottiaux对这一趋势做出了深刻观察：
"ChatGPT——无论你是否理解这个名字，它都将长期存在。它是过去、现在和未来。是AI的同义词，很快也将成为代理的同义词。"
这种趋势在Codex的用户数据中得到了具体体现。Zara Zhang引用了OpenAI最新报告的关键发现：
"知识工作者现在占Codex用户的约20%，其采用速度比开发者快3倍以上。知识工作者增长最快的任务类型是：数据分析（110%周环比增长）；研究（+37%）和知识构件（+36%）"
swyx对此表示认同，称"codex是AGI，兄弟"，并强调其在推理效率方面的突破。

💼 企业AI平台的新突破

企业级AI工具正在迎来重大升级。tariq宣布了Claude工作流程的重大改进：
"工作流程是Claude Code自技能和子代理以来功能的最大升级。我与@sidbid深入研究了最佳实践、示例等。我特别兴奋的是它为Claude Code启用的非技术任务。"
同时，企业合作伙伴关系也在加强。Amjad Masad宣布与微软的合作，将"让企业中的每个人都能构建和部署安全可靠的Fabric数据应用"，这得益于微软的新Rayfin SDK。 Gemini也在扩展其能力，Josh Woodward宣布"思维层级现在可在Web、iOS和Android上的Gemini中使用"。

企业采用的智能路由趋势

Aaron Levie指出了企业AI应用的关键趋势：
"随着令牌预算在运营费用中占据更大份额，模型路由是不可避免的结论。这也是应用AI层未来最大的差异化领域之一。通过理解你所在领域的不同工作模式，并对该领域进行强有力的评估，你将能够有效地优化成本/性能。"

💡 "是代码"革命：重新定义开发

Guillermo Rauch提出了"是代码"概念，彻底颠覆了无代码运动的理念：
"整个'无代码'软件类别都建立在代码昂贵、困难和稀缺的假设之上。编码代理永远改变了这个等式。代码现在便宜、简单、充足。"
他进一步解释了这种转变的教育意义：
"这就是AI时代的教育样子。从语言开始：语言表面是你的路线图。就像SDK有一组函数定义一样，人类语言是通向世界的新API。"
这种观点得到了实际应用的支持，Rauch还宣布Vercel将为新兴的代理开发环境Conductor提供沙盒支持：
"Conductor具有作为为编码代理而生的IDE的独特优势。如果你愿意，可以称之为ADE（代理开发环境）。"

🏗️ SaaS模式面临挑战

传统SaaS模式正面临来自AI原生解决方案的挑战。Peter Yang分析了这种转变：
"人们说SaaS没有死。我认为能够处理多项工作的大型企业SaaS可能没问题（例如Figma）。但如果你正在为狭窄用例构建简单的SaaS，我认为现在货币化更困难，因为：1. AI技能通常能以更灵活、个性化的方式解决同样的问题。2. 拥有用户个人上下文和记忆的AI原生代理如Codex/Claude Code拥有远比独立SaaS网站或聊天机器人更多的知识来解决用户问题。"

🔬 创新工具生态系统

新的创新工具正在涌现。Zara Zhang庆祝了Frontend Slides的里程碑："Frontend Slides现在在GitHub上有2万颗星。令人难以置信的是，有这么多人已经用HTML幻灯片替换了PPT，再也不回头了。" 与此同时，Garry Tan推荐了"GBrain是用于检索和记忆的代理瑞士军刀"。
投资视角方面，Nikunj Agrawal强调了当前融资环境的复杂性，指出成功的创始人需要在AI/时机、资金、分销、市场、产品和收入等多个维度展现独特优势。 随着AI代理能力的不断增强和企业采用的加速，我们正在见证一个从根本上重新定义软件开发、商业模式和人机交互的时代。
